confidence_notes: Holistic estimate based on general Slovenian and Lake Bled visitor-market knowledge. Food anchors are more stable; late-November lodging is less certain because seasonal closures and limited availability can shift rates. Cocktail and wine estimates follow their usual local price relationship to beer.
comparable_city_reasoning: Used Slovenian euro-area pricing and nearby Alpine visitor towns as broad comparators. Bled's visitor demand supports a premium over smaller non-tourist towns, while mid-November is outside the summer peak.
